# Tech Mind Developers

> Tech Mind Developers (TMD) is an established full-cycle software engineering company founded in 2014, headquartered in Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi, India, with technical delivery centers in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh. The firm specializes in bespoke enterprise ERP systems, AI chatbots, mobile application development, diagnostic pathology lab software (LIMS), educational institute ERPs, and industrial manufacturing automation with 100% lifetime source code ownership and zero monthly software rent.

## Geographical Footprint & Delivery Centers
- **Headquarters (Delhi NCR)**: Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi, Delhi 110020, India
- **Regional Delivery Hub (UP)**: Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, India
- **Delhi NCR Coverage**: South Delhi, Nehru Place, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad
- **Uttar Pradesh Coverage**: Aligarh, Lucknow, Agra, Meerut
- **Global Delivery Footprint**: Pan-India, United States, United Kingdom, and the United Arab Emirates

## Industries Served
- **Healthcare & Diagnostic Centers**: Pathology LIMS, diagnostic reporting, and dental clinic management
- **Education & Institutions**: School ERP, college administration, coaching academy student portals
- **Manufacturing & Supply Chain**: Production tracking, job-work challans, inventory, and export billing
- **Retail & E-Commerce**: D2C storefronts, B2B wholesale distribution, and UPI payment automation
- **Fitness & Wellness**: Gym access turnstiles, biometric membership, and trainer management
- **Corporate & Professional Services**: Custom CRM, billing portals, and automated business workflows

## Core Service Pillars

- [Custom Software Development](https://techminddevelopers.in/custom-software-development.html): Tailor-made web applications, microservices, cloud portals, and automated business workflows engineered using Python, ASP.NET Core, Node.js, and modern React.
- [Enterprise ERP & CRM Software](https://techminddevelopers.in/erp-crm-software-development.html): Comprehensive multi-branch ERP platforms, customer management portals, automated invoicing, real-time inventory ledgers, and staff payroll systems.
- [AI Chatbots & Autonomous AI Agents](https://techminddevelopers.in/ai-chatbot-automation-services.html): Autonomous AI agents, context-aware LLM customer support bots, automated WhatsApp business workflows, and automated CRM lead capture pipelines.
- [Mobile App Development](https://techminddevelopers.in/mobile-app-development.html): Native Android and iOS, cross-platform Flutter and React Native mobile applications with real-time push notifications and offline sync.
- [Website Design & Development](https://techminddevelopers.in/website-design-development.html): High-speed corporate websites, conversion-optimized landing pages, SEO-first architecture, and bespoke UI/UX design.
- [Ecommerce Development](https://techminddevelopers.in/ecommerce-development.html): Custom high-speed online stores with direct UPI QR checkout, instant WhatsApp order notifications, and zero commission per transaction.
- [Digital Marketing & Technical SEO](https://techminddevelopers.in/blog/best-seo-company-okhla-delhi.html): Technical SEO audits, local Google search dominance, organic traffic growth, entity schema optimization, and conversion-focused digital marketing campaigns.
- [IT Consulting & Enterprise Architecture](https://techminddevelopers.in/custom-software-development.html): Strategic technology consulting, legacy system refactoring, cloud migration planning, and single-tenant enterprise database architecture.

## Specialized Industry ERP Verticals

- [Pathology Lab Software (LIMS)](https://techminddevelopers.in/pathology-lab-software.html): Diagnostic center software featuring barcode vacutainer tracking, abnormal test flags, instant WhatsApp PDF reports, and doctor referral accounting.
- [Dental Clinic Management Software](https://techminddevelopers.in/dental-clinic-management-software.html): Multi-chair dental appointment scheduling, visual odontogram tooth charts, automated WhatsApp appointment reminders, and digital prescription builder.
- [Gym & Fitness Management Software](https://techminddevelopers.in/gym-fitness-management-software.html): Biometric turnstile gate auto-lock on expiry, automated WhatsApp fee renewal alerts, and personal trainer commission tracking.
- [School & Coaching Institute ERP](https://techminddevelopers.in/school-coaching-management-software.html): RFID biometric student attendance with instant WhatsApp absent alerts to parents, automated fee receipts, and marksheet generator.
- [Manufacturing & Hardware ERP](https://techminddevelopers.in/manufacturing-hardware-erp.html): Raw material melting scrap tracking, outside job-work delivery challans, karigar piece-rate wages, and multi-currency export billing.

## Engineering Stack
- **Backend**: Python (Django, FastAPI), C# / ASP.NET Core, Node.js, PHP
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Modern JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Mobile**: Flutter, React Native, Native Android (Kotlin), iOS (Swift)
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Linux VPS (Ubuntu), Docker, Nginx, Cloudflare
- **Hardware & API Integrations**: WhatsApp Cloud API, Razorpay, Cashfree, UPI QR, Biometric machines (eSSL, ZKTeco via SDK), Electronic weighing scales (RS232 serial)

1. **100% Code Ownership**: Clients obtain complete intellectual property, database schema, and source code with zero monthly software licensing fees.
2. **Physical Engineering Base in Delhi NCR & UP**: On-ground technical deployment, hardware setup, and face-to-face consultation across South Delhi, Noida, and Aligarh.
